record.reason: The primary abstract describes ELMo contextual word representations learned from internal states of a pretrained bidirectional language model and downstream NLP accuracy improvements. It does not describe a serving system or an inference-time efficiency/compression contribution; the use of a language model as a representation source alone is insufficient for this scope.
record.title: Deep Contextualized Word Representations
